api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Accounts: List Accounts

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports OrganizationName, PartyNumber, Type, Status, PrimaryEmailAddress, SalesAccountStatus. Example: q=Type='CUSTOMER' and SalesAccountStatus='Active'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: contacts, opportunities, addresses, phones, salesTeam, customFields
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.
api_arguments.orderBy: string: Sort field and direction. Example: orderBy=OrganizationName:asc

functionality: Retrieves a list of customer accounts from Oracle CX Sales. Supports filtering by type, status, and name.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Accounts: Get an Account

api_arguments.PartyId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the account.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: contacts, opportunities, addresses, phones, salesTeam, revenue
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves full details of a specific customer account including address, contacts, and sales team assignments.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Accounts: Create an Account

api_arguments.Type: string: Account type. Valid values: CUSTOMER, PARTNER, COMPETITOR, PROSPECT. Default: CUSTOMER.
api_arguments.AnnualRevenue: number: Estimated annual revenue of the account.
api_arguments.PrimaryEmailAddress: string: Primary email address for the account.
api_arguments.OwnerId: integer: PersonId of the sales representative who owns this account.
api_arguments.ParentAccountPartyId: integer: PartyId of the parent account for hierarchical account structures.

functionality: Creates a new customer account in Oracle CX Sales.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Contacts: List Contacts

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports LastName, FirstName, EmailAddress, AccountPartyId, JobTitle, Status. Example: q=AccountPartyId=300000001234567
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: phones, emails, addresses, relationships
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves a list of contacts. Filter by account to get all contacts associated with a specific customer.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Contacts: Create a Contact

api_arguments.LastName: [REQUIRED] string: Last name of the contact.
api_arguments.FirstName: string: First name of the contact.
api_arguments.AccountPartyId: integer: PartyId of the account this contact belongs to.
api_arguments.PhoneCountryCode: string: Country code for the phone number. Example: '1' for US.
api_arguments.PreferredContactMethod: string: Preferred method of contact. Valid values: EMAIL, PHONE, MAIL.
api_arguments.DoNotContact: boolean: If true, marks the contact as do-not-contact. Default is false.
api_arguments.OwnerId: integer: PersonId of the sales rep who owns this contact.

functionality: Creates a new contact and optionally associates it with an existing account.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Opportunities: List Opportunities

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports Name, Status, SalesStage, AccountPartyId, OwnerId, CloseDate, Amount. Example: q=SalesStage='Proposal' and CloseDate <= '2024-12-31'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: contacts, revenue, salesTeam, competitors, leads, activities
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves a list of sales opportunities. Filter by stage, owner, or close date to build pipeline views.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Opportunities: Get an Opportunity

api_arguments.OptyId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the opportunity.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: contacts, revenue, salesTeam, competitors, activities, assessments
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves full details of a specific sales opportunity including revenue lines, sales team, and linked contacts.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Opportunities: Create an Opportunity

api_arguments.Name: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the opportunity.
api_arguments.AccountPartyId: [REQUIRED] integer: PartyId of the account associated with this opportunity.
api_arguments.SalesStage: [REQUIRED] string: Current stage. Valid values: Qualification, Proposal, Negotiation, Closing.
api_arguments.WinProb: integer: Probability of winning expressed as a percentage (0-100).
api_arguments.CloseDate: [REQUIRED] string: Expected close date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.Revenue: number: Expected revenue value for this opportunity.
api_arguments.OwnerId: integer: PersonId of the sales rep who owns this opportunity.
api_arguments.Description: string: Description or notes about the opportunity.
api_arguments.LeadSource: string: Source of the opportunity. Example: 'WEB', 'REFERRAL', 'TRADE_SHOW'.

functionality: Creates a new sales opportunity linked to a customer account.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Opportunities: Update an Opportunity

api_arguments.OptyId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the opportunity to update.
api_arguments.CloseDate: string: Updated expected close date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.Status: string: Opportunity status. Valid values: Open, Won, Lost.
api_arguments.StatusComment: string: Reason for status change, especially for Won or Lost.

functionality: Updates an existing opportunity. Used to advance the sales stage, update forecast, or mark as won or lost.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Leads: List Leads

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports LastName, CompanyName, Status, Rating, OwnerId, CreationDate. Example: q=Status='New' and Rating='Hot'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: phones, emails, addresses, activities
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves a list of sales leads. Filter by status or rating to prioritize follow-up actions.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Leads: Create a Lead

api_arguments.LastName: [REQUIRED] string: Last name of the lead.
api_arguments.FirstName: string: First name of the lead.
api_arguments.CompanyName: string: Company the lead is associated with.
api_arguments.EmailAddress: string: Email address of the lead.
api_arguments.PhoneNumber: string: Phone number of the lead.
api_arguments.LeadSource: string: Source of the lead. Example: 'INBOUND_CALL', 'WEB_FORM', 'TRADE_SHOW'.
api_arguments.Rating: string: Lead quality rating. Valid values: Hot, Warm, Cold.
api_arguments.Status: string: Lead status. Valid values: New, In Progress, Converted, Dead.
api_arguments.Description: string: Notes or description about the lead.
api_arguments.OwnerId: integer: PersonId of the sales rep assigned to this lead.
api_arguments.CurrencyCode: string: Currency for lead revenue estimates. Example: 'USD'.
api_arguments.Budget: number: Estimated budget of the prospect.

functionality: Creates a new sales lead. Leads can later be converted into accounts, contacts, and opportunities.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Leads: Convert a Lead

api_arguments.LeadId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the lead to convert.
api_arguments.CreateAccount: boolean: If true, creates a new account from the lead company details. Default is true.
api_arguments.CreateContact: boolean: If true, creates a new contact from the lead person details. Default is true.
api_arguments.CreateOpportunity: boolean: If true, creates a new opportunity linked to the converted account. Default is false.
api_arguments.ExistingAccountPartyId: integer: If provided, links the converted contact and opportunity to this existing account instead of creating a new one.

functionality: Converts a qualified lead into account, contact, and optionally opportunity records.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Activities: List Activities

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ActivityType, Status, OwnerId, AssignedToPartyId, PlannedStartDate. Example: q=ActivityType='CALL' and Status='Open'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: contacts, accounts, opportunities, resources
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves sales activities such as calls, tasks, and appointments linked to accounts and opportunities.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Activities: Create an Activity

api_arguments.ActivityType: [REQUIRED] string: Type of activity. Valid values: CALL, TASK, APPOINTMENT.
api_arguments.Subject: [REQUIRED] string: Subject or title of the activity.
api_arguments.Status: string: Status of the activity. Valid values: Not Started, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled. Default: Not Started.
api_arguments.PlannedStartDate: string: Planned start date and time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
api_arguments.PlannedEndDate: string: Planned end date and time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
api_arguments.Priority: string: Priority of the activity. Valid values: High, Normal, Low.
api_arguments.Description: string: Notes or description of the activity.
api_arguments.OwnerId: integer: PersonId of the activity owner.
api_arguments.AccountPartyId: integer: PartyId of the linked account.
api_arguments.OptyId: integer: Identifier of the linked opportunity.

functionality: Creates a new sales activity — a call log, task, or appointment — and optionally links it to an account or opportunity.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Sales Forecasts: Get Sales Forecast Summary

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ForecastPeriodId, OwnerId, ForecastCategory, Status. Example: q=ForecastCategory='Pipeline'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: items, adjustments
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves sales forecast summaries by period and owner. Used to review pipeline, best case, and commit amounts.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Sales Territories: List Sales Territories

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports Name, Status, OwnerId, ParentTerritoryId. Example: q=Status='Active'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: members, dimensions, quotas
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves the sales territory hierarchy used to assign accounts, contacts, and opportunities to sales teams.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Quotes: List Quotes

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports QuoteNumber, Status, AccountPartyId, OptyId, ExpirationDate. Example: q=Status='Draft' and OptyId=300000001234567
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, contacts, charges
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves sales quotes linked to opportunities. Quotes become orders when accepted.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Sales Orders from Quote: Submit Quote as Order

api_arguments.QuoteId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the quote to submit as an order.
api_arguments.RequestedShipDate: string: Requested shipping date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
api_arguments.Comments: string: Additional comments or instructions for the order.

functionality: Submits an accepted quote to Oracle Order Management as a sales order.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Sales Partners: List Partners

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports OrganizationName, PartnerType, Status, Tier. Example: q=Status='Active' and Tier='Gold'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: contacts, deals, certifications
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves channel partners registered in Oracle Partner Relationship Management.

api_name: REST API for Oracle CX Sales Cloud - Deal Registrations: Create a Deal Registration

api_arguments.PartnerPartyId: [REQUIRED] integer: PartyId of the partner registering the deal.
api_arguments.CustomerName: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the end customer.
api_arguments.CustomerEmailAddress: string: Primary email of the customer contact.
api_arguments.ProductLine: string: Oracle product line the deal is related to.
api_arguments.ExpectedCloseDate: [REQUIRED] string: Estimated deal close date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.Description: string: Description of the deal and opportunity.
api_arguments.CompetitorName: string: Name of the primary competitor for this deal.

functionality: Creates a deal registration for a channel partner to claim a new opportunity and protect their margin.
